keys.name: Synergysave2
keys.description: Official Synergism progress. Base64 of the JSON written by saveSynergy. Preference keys are not part of this save.

compatibility.notes: Live reference is Synergism 4.4.0 (Pseudo-Corp/SynergismOfficial 01b246de). Newer semver saves are rejected. Capture uses the settings save control, which calls saveSynergy(true). exportSynergism is not used.

resourceObservations.observed: The settings button #savegame calls the normal save. It writes localStorage Synergysave2 as Base64 JSON and does not grant export quarks. Autosave is 5000 ms and is skipped while offline simulation is active.
